entries.test: Public user reactions, reviews, and comparisons of GPT-5's prelaunch hype with its delivered capabilities would establish whether disappointment was widespread and support or undermine the overhype characterization.
entries.note: Widespread disappointment is testable; the historical overhype ranking is an explicitly qualified judgment.

entries.test: Marcus's January 2024 essay, longitudinal evaluations of LLM capabilities through January 2026, and public court records would test the warning, claimed plateau, and extent of OpenAI's litigation.
entries.note: The earlier warning was tentative, but he now firmly asserts that the plateau occurred.

entries.test: Public OpenAI policy announcements, statements about government financial support, and reporting linking those initiatives to its financial pressures would support or contradict the claimed explanation.
entries.note: “Small wonder” presents these moves as understandable consequences of the business problems discussed immediately before.
